newsitem.title: USA: Duramed sees product approvals in 2nd half.
newsitem.headline: Duramed sees product approvals in 2nd half.

text.p: Generic drug maker Duramed Pharaceuticals Inc said Wednesday it expects to receive U.S. Food and Drug Administration approvals during the second half on several product petitions it has pending.

"Duramed is working to return to profitability and expects several product approvals in the second half of this year," company chairman and chief executive officer Thomas Arington said in a press release.
"The previously announced private placement provided Duramed with additional capital to maintain its steady pace of new product development," Arington said.

In May Duramed reported a widened first quarter loss of $6.8 million, or $0.46 per share, on revenues of $10.74 million versus a 1996 first quarter loss of $2.2 million, or $0.28 per share, on revenues of $10.70 million.
